name: Agni Green Power Ltd.
summary: Agni Green Power Ltd. operates within the renewable energy sector, primarily focusing on providing turnkey solutions for solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant projects across India. The company offers a comprehensive range of services including the design, engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of both stand-alone and grid-connected PV systems. It also manufactures and sells various solar products such as solar PV modules, solar water heating systems, solar inverters, solar lighting systems, solar power packs, solar power conditioning units, and solar pumps. Agni Green Power Ltd. targets diverse clients including government agencies, public sector undertakings, and commercial and industrial entities, serving sectors like rural electrification, agriculture, and rooftop solar applications. The company further provides consultancy, feasibility studies, and training programs related to solar PV systems.
